title: Stuck tokens during the Exodus Mode
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, tokens stuck  **Likelihood:** Medium, it must be pending withdrawals, and the Exodus Mode enabled  ## Description  During the Exodus Mode users can prove their Nume balance and call `withdrawExodus()` to withdraw NFTs not yet withdrawn and that have not received approval in `notarizeSettlement()` yet. Also, users can have some funds already approved. In this case, they have to call `withdrawNFT()` manually, which is the final step to finalize the approved withdrawals.
